concept.subject: A swing carousel's canopy seen from below and in front: its crest of gold-trimmed arches with painted medallions and red hearts, the red rim studded with bulbs, and the radial panels, chains and swing seats of its underside.
concept.composition: The crest fills the upper half. Two big arches meet in a V just right of the top center under a white finial ball, their tops at a fifth of the height, and a smaller arch at each side runs down to the edges at a third. In the teal band under them two oval medallions with painted landscapes sit at a third and two thirds of the width, two more are cut off by the edges, and three red hearts point up between them, the middle one under the V. The red rim curves across the picture as a low dome at half the height. Below it the underside spreads in radial panels, red in the middle and edged with two rows of bulbs, pale yellow and gray-green beside it, hung with chains and swing seats above the scalloped hub at the bottom center.
concept.layout: 29 round pegs and 110 bricks. Each big arch's gold trim is a solid top over its medallion that runs on as a brick slide down past the side heart's outer side; on the left the solid bends down into the V. The middle heart's top is a solid over its two brick sides. The medallion frames are brick rings open at the bottom with two pegs in each painting, the cut-off medallions are brick caps, the small arches rows of bulb pegs and a bulb peg sits inside the left heart. The rim is two long brick slides falling from a solid crown under the middle heart to the walls. Under it the panel edges are brick ribs, the red panel's bulbs two peg rows, the hub a low brick dome and the far side of the rim a brick row at each side; the chains and hangers are pegs and the swing seats one or two bricks. Gaps a Big Ball could wedge in are kept at 18 px or more.

difficulty.note: Second easiest of the stage. A shot through the gap beside the middle heart lands on the rim beside its crown and rides a half of it to the wall, but the solid arch tops, the middle heart's solid top and the left arch's solid hook into the V keep balls off the left medallion, where most orange pegs gather.

background.prompt: The canopy of a painted swing carousel against an overcast sky, seen from below and in front, in the stage's cream, brick red and turquoise. The crest fills the upper half: its upper edge is a gold trim studded with bulbs that forms two big arches, their tops at about 0.38 and 0.67 of the width and a fifth of the height, meeting in a V at about 0.52 of the width and a quarter of the height under a thin pole with a white ball; a smaller arch at each side runs down to the edges at about a third of the height. In the teal band below, two oval medallions with painted landscapes (a lake with trees on the left, a village by a pond on the right) are centered at about 0.35 and 0.68 of the width and 0.37 of the height, two more are cut off by the edges, and three red hearts with gold borders point up between them, the middle one from 0.28 to 0.49 of the height under the V. The bulb-studded red rim curves across as a low dome from about 0.6 of the height at the edges to half the height in the middle. Below it the canopy's underside spreads in radial panels, a red middle panel edged with two rows of bulbs converging toward the hub and pale yellow and gray-green panels beside it, with chains and swing seats hanging down and the scalloped green and red hub at the bottom center from about 0.83 of the height.

picture.title: A brightly colored carousel with artistic scenes under a clear sky.
picture.author: Anzor Dukaev
